originalTitle: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru

content: Starbucks could eventually show you a personalized digital menu when you pull up to the drive-thru. During an earnings call on Thursday, Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore “experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless,” as spotted earlier by More Perfect Union. It sounds similar to the technology that Taco Bell is experimenting with, which could change the layout, content, and visuals on a digital menu board “on a car-by-car basis.” McDonald’s also recently showed off an AI-powered feature it’s piloting at a handful of drive-thrus, allowing its “ArchIQ” chatbot to identify repeat customers and let them order their “usual.” Starting in 2027, Starbucks will also begin testing background AI models at the drive-thru to help baristas “input orders more accurately and efficiently,” according to Niccol. The company also plans to integrate AI into the Starbucks app’s search and discovery features, and may allow “conversational and agentic” ordering in the future. Starbucks has already started allowing customers to place orders through ChatGPT, and also rolled out an AI-powered Green Dot Assist that employees can use to ask questions about things like recipes and service standards. It’s still not clear how soon we can expect to see personalized digital menu boards at Starbucks, but Niccol says it’s still “early,” adding that “we’ll test, learn, and scale what works.”
chineseTitle: 星巴克希望利用 AI 在得来速餐厅向你展示“个性化数字菜单”
chineseSummary: 当你把车停在得来速餐厅前时，星巴克最终可能会向你展示个性化的数字菜单。在周四的财报电话会议上，星巴克首席执行官布莱恩·尼科尔(Brian Niccol)表示，正如 More […]
chineseContent: 当你把车停在得来速餐厅前时，星巴克最终可能会向你展示个性化的数字菜单。在周四的财报电话会议上，星巴克首席执行官布莱恩·尼科尔 (Brian Niccol) 表示，正如 More Perfect Union 早些时候发现的那样，该公司将探索“在参与的顾客到达时识别他们、提供个性化数字菜单并使付款更加轻松的体验”。这听起来与塔可钟正在试验的技术类似，该技术可以“逐辆车”地改变数字菜单板上的布局、内容和视觉效果。麦当劳最近还展示了一项人工智能驱动的功能，该功能正在少数得来速餐厅进行试点，允许其“ArchIQ”聊天机器人识别回头客并让他们点“常吃的”菜。 Niccol 表示，从 2027 年开始，星巴克还将开始在得来速餐厅测试后台人工智能模型，以帮助咖啡师“更准确、更高效地输入订单”。该公司还计划将人工智能集成到星巴克应用程序的搜索和发现功能中，并可能在未来允许“对话式和代理式”订购。星巴克已经开始允许顾客通过 ChatGPT 下订单，还推出了人工智能驱动的 Green Dot Assist，员工可以用它来询问有关食谱和服务标准等问题。目前还不清楚我们多久才能在星巴克看到个性化数字菜单板，但尼科尔表示现在还“为时过早”，并补充说“我们将测试、学习和扩展有效的方法”。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
